name: Roc Gizzard
summary: A Roc Gizzard is a part of the rocs found in Tanaris. Rhapsody Shindigger needs three for a strong drink he hopes will loosen his tongue.

sections.title: A Stronger Drink
sections.body: Rhapsody Shindigger in the Hinterlands asks you to bring him three Roc Gizzards from Tanaris. He needs them for a Kalimdor Kocktail, along with livers from Feralas. Rhapsody says the drink will help him speak of a frightening flight over a swamp.

faq.q: Where do Roc Gizzards come from?
faq.answer: Rocs, Fire Rocs, and Searing Rocs in Tanaris yield Roc Gizzards.
Rhapsody Shindigger in the Hinterlands needs three Roc Gizzards for his Kalimdor Kocktail.
It is a strong drink Rhapsody Shindigger means to make with Roc Gizzards and livers from Feralas.

faq.q: Why does Rhapsody want the drink?
faq.answer: Rhapsody says he needs something strong before he can speak of a frightening flight over a swamp.
